description.p: A lightweight streaming desktop client for Linux. It wraps the official web players of supported services (Disney+, Netflix) in a dedicated Chromium shell with Widevine support, hardware video decoding, MPRIS media controls and a tray icon.

This is an unofficial, community-built client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any streaming service or its owner. Disney+ and Netflix are trademarks of their respective owners. A valid subscription to the chosen service is required, and the app simply plays the official web player.
